clips.title: The story
paras: Near the Den in the Valley of Trials, Galgar feeds young recruits serving the Horde. He asks newcomers to gather wild cactus apples for his Cactus Apple Surprise.

Galgar cooks near the Den's fire in the Valley of Trials, feeding young orcs and trolls through their first rites of passage. Durotar is a dry, harsh red wasteland, where food must be found across the land. Galgar sends novice warriors to gather ripe cactus fruit, testing their attention and resilience while stocking his kitchen.

Galgar's specialty is called Cactus Apple Surprise. He says gathering spiny desert fruit is a simple task meant to ease fresh recruits into adventuring. The dish still feeds hungry trainees. Every Horde warrior begins somewhere, and Galgar starts them with foraging in the desert.
